title: Raiders hold Kirk Cousins, Maxx Crosby out of Saturday's practice due to Friday's fight

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Raiders hold Kirk Cousins, Maxx Crosby out of Saturday's practice due to Friday's fight
sources.description: Raiders quarterback Kirk Cousins and defensive end Maxx Crosby got into a scuffle during practice on Friday and they received some extra time to cool off on Saturday.
